use_case: UC1 – Air quality and traffic: explaining poor-air days and warning clinic patients (Valdena Civic Health Office, IT)
objective_summary: Decide whether the poor-air-day warning method can be prototyped now on public hourly Italian air-quality data (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) while the city's own station data is requested, and whether the city's own data (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) covers hourly air quality, traffic, weather and daily respiratory clinic counts by district at the needed grain. Also identify unusable data and red flags to resolve before profiling.

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly concentrations of NO2 and/or PM2.5 (and ideally PM10/O3) at fixed urban monitoring stations in one Italian city, covering the prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, with station id, pollutant, unit and validity flag per reading.
internal_queries: hourly air quality station readings NO2 PM2.5
city monitoring station data request status
external_data_hints: Prototype: national or regional environment agency (ISPRA, ARPA/regional open-data portal, or EEA air-quality data) for an Italian urban background station, hourly, 2004-03 to 2005-04. Check the station is urban and that the series is validated, not raw; trap: many open portals start after 2013 and will not cover the prototype window.

Production fallback: EEA Air Quality e-Reporting or the regional ARPA open-data portal, hourly, 2024-2025, same city as the client's station(s). Trap: EEA reporting is often delayed and may be aggregated; check the station codes against the city's own feed.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly or finer grain with timestamps in a stated timezone (UTC or local, DST handled)
Prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 fully covered with less than an agreed share of gaps, gaps documented
Production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 covered by the city's own station data (or a documented public equivalent)
Station location (city, lat/long, type urban/traffic/background) recorded
Licence of each source read at its source; open-data licence confirmed for prototyping use
Unit and pollutant definitions documented (µg/m³, reference method)
likely_pitfalls: Renamed or migrated station codes across years break joins
Unit changes (µg/m³ vs mg/m³ or ppb) and changes in measurement method over time
Validated vs provisional data: recent months often unvalidated
Mixing traffic-type and background stations without flagging
Prototype data from a different city than the client's: must be recorded as an assumption
Daylight-saving and UTC offset mismatches when joining to weather

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly vehicle traffic counts or flows on roads near the monitoring stations for the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, keyed to the same station or road segment as N1.
external_data_hints: City or province mobility / transport office open-data portal reporting hourly vehicle counts on named road segments, 2024-2025. Trap: counts from loop sensors may be missing for periods; check for a mapping from road segment to monitoring station, which often does not exist publicly.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly grain for 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 with less than an agreed share of missing hours
Each traffic series linked to a named road segment with a documented distance to a station in N1
Vehicle count definition and sensor type documented
Source owner and licence confirmed; internal source preferred
likely_pitfalls: No register source exists for traffic; any external feed needs its own agreement and Legal review
Sensor outages and counting method changes create false trends
Holiday and roadworks effects not separable without a calendar
Aggregated daily totals cannot support an hourly model

need_plans.interpretation: Hourly air temperature and relative humidity at or near the city in the prototype and production windows, timestamped in UTC or local time, with a stated coordinate.
external_data_hints: Prototype/production: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis) at the chosen city coordinates, hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m. Trap: reanalysis is modelled, not station observation; record that. Also consider the regional ARPA meteo station as a station-based alternative, 2004-2025 hourly.
acceptance_criteria: Hourly temperature and relative humidity covering both windows with no gaps in the joined period
Coordinates recorded (the chosen city location, recorded as an assumption in decisions.md)
Timezone set explicitly to UTC and converted consistently with N1
Data type (reanalysis vs station) recorded in the metadata
likely_pitfalls: Register default coordinates are Lisbon and must not be used
AtmosData vendor feed is expired (contract AD-2021-114 ended 2025-12-31, key revoked 2026-01-01): do not use
Reanalysis smooths local extremes and may not represent street-level conditions
Keep API probe ranges short during discovery

need_plans.interpretation: Daily counts of respiratory clinic visits per district for the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31, provided by the clinic as aggregate counts only.
internal_queries: respiratory clinic visits daily counts district
external_data_hints: Internal clinic data only. If not available internally, the regional health service (Italian ASL/Regione open-data or health information system) may publish monthly or annual respiratory admissions by district; that is annual or monthly, not daily, and would not meet the grain.
acceptance_criteria: Daily grain by district for the full production window
Counts only; no patient identifiers or small-cell counts that allow re-identification (threshold to be set by Legal)
Diagnosis/visit-type definition documented (ICD or clinic coding)
Data-sharing agreement or clinic sign-off in place
likely_pitfalls: Clinic coding changed mid-period, altering respiratory definition
District boundaries changed; district code systems may not join to other data
Weekend and holiday effects in scheduling
Counts can be suppressed for small districts

need_plans.interpretation: Patient-level visit events for respiratory patients. Explicitly out of scope per the brief: the clinic may only share daily counts by district.
acceptance_criteria: Not pursued: the brief rules out individual patient records
If requested later, requires a separate lawful-basis and consent review before any access
likely_pitfalls: Patient-level extracts would carry personal data; do not copy identifiers into discovery outputs
Consent may be captured late or not at all for historic records

need_plans.interpretation: National yearly estimates of deaths attributable to PM2.5 for Italy, covering at least 2004-2005 and 2024-2025, used only as context.
external_data_hints: National statistics or health institute (ISTAT, Istituto Superiore di Sanità) or EEA attributable-mortality estimates for Italy, annual, 2004-2005 and 2024-2025. Trap: modelled estimates differ by method (GBD vs EEA); record which method and do not compare directly across sources.
acceptance_criteria: Annual grain covering both windows (or the years nearest them, documented)
Method and model of attribution stated
Italy-level, not regional or European aggregate
Licence/terms read at source
likely_pitfalls: Modelled estimates revised over time; use the latest vintage and record it
Attribution methods change between editions, creating false trends
Not usable as a predictor; context only

open_questions: Which Italian city is the client? The brief says choose a justified location and record it in decisions.md; the Open-Meteo coordinates depend on this. Please confirm or supply the city and the station coordinates.
Has the city's station data request been raised with a named owner and expected date? The prototype depends on it.
Which air-quality station(s) and which road-traffic sensors does the city own, and do they map to each other?
Is there a lawful basis and Legal sign-off for the clinic's daily district counts (N4), including the small-cell suppression threshold?
Renewal of the AtmosData vendor contract is waiting on Procurement. Is the station-grade weather feed still needed, or is Open-Meteo plus the regional meteo station enough?
Does Legal accept the open-data policy for the prototype use of public Italian datasets, and do any of the three example links in links/UC1_example_links.json need a licence check first?
Traffic (N2) has no register entry. Does the city have an internal traffic feed, and who approves an external one for production?
